# Video project record (copy and fill)

A lightweight index, not an MSR schema. Keep private locally by default. Use paths
relative to this record for project files; retain authoritative receipts unchanged.
Do not include credentials, private prompts, personal participant details or
machine-specific absolute paths in public examples. Review consent and content
before sharing. Use [portable-project export/preflight](../portable-projects.md) for transferring inputs.
